case_scope: South Africa national wealth order with land, racialized closure, unemployment, and state-capacity constraints

bottom_50_private_wealth_share.note: South Africa remains a hard fail on wealth/income distribution and racialized asset inheritance; official/multilateral sources keep share plausibility blocked.

middle_40_private_wealth_share.note: Middle wealth formation is constrained by unemployment, spatial exclusion, and weak public inputs.

top_1_private_wealth_share.note: High inequality and land/control closure keep top-tail compression and anti-capture screens active.

public_social_counterweight.note: Transfers and services matter, but unemployment, infrastructure gaps, crime, debt, and service-delivery failures prevent a public counterweight pass.

lower_half_real_floor.note: Q1 2026 unemployment and persistent poverty/service constraints block any real-floor pass; labour-market access is a live currentness gate.

early_foothold_open_access.note: Job access, land/title history, education/location, infrastructure, and credit barriers prevent broad open circulation into durable wealth footholds.

parent_backed_threshold_dependency.note: Family/community support may substitute for weak formal entry; direct transfer/household support data needed.

group_person_closure.note: Race, place, youth, gender, land, and labour-market exclusion require anti-averaging; national averages hide claimant-level closure.

housing_land_washout.note: Land/title, spatial apartheid, and defensible-tenure gaps are dominant washout surfaces.

debt_fee_washout.note: Informal credit, debt, fees, and unstable incomes can erase gains; direct household debt data needed.

wealth_to_rule_risk.note: Procurement, land entities, trusts, companies, political finance, and monopoly channels need visibility.

ownership_legibility.note: Land/entity classification and historical title/beneficial ownership gaps keep owner visibility and redress targeting incomplete.

climate_insurance_drag.note: Climate/infrastructure risk needs a separate stress surface.

digital_intangible_concentration.note: Less central than land/labor/service closure in this active bounded read.

dynastic_infrastructure_pressure.note: Entity landholding and trust/company opacity can preserve closure.

monetary_asset_price_channel.note: Less central than real-economy and land/place failures in current case.

case_notes: Captured-order verdict is based on combined racialized closure, floor failure, and legibility/state-capacity constraints, not merely a high Gini claim.
